card.name: Linking words in researcher title phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right after a named researcher's name or title, just before a role like associate, assistant, chair or professor. Also fires on commas that begin a relative clause.

modes.label: Researcher titles
modes.description: A conjunction, comma or rank word inside a quoted expert's job description in news-style text.
modes.example: Picker serves as director of the VGTI's vaccine program and<< associate>> director of the VGTI.

modes.label: Clause-opening commas
modes.description: A comma after a treatment phrase that leads into 'which patients' or 'who supervised'.
modes.example: at the inception of neuroleptic treatment<<,>> which patients are likely to develop the syndrome
